context: Evaluates the two rules that keep a goal bounded: discovered work is a follow-up unless the end state is unreachable without it, and a goal that outgrows the five-item threshold is promoted to a plan and recorded as promoted rather than completed. Covers Workflow steps 2 and 5, Core Rule 4, and the scope-growth anti-pattern.

checklist.name: Discovered-work test applied
checklist.description: The agent checks whether the stated end state is reachable without the new work before adding it

checklist.name: Test result stated
checklist.description: The response says the end state is reachable without the cache work, so the default is a follow-up

checklist.name: Not appended silently
checklist.description: The sixth row is not added without comment, leaving the goal over threshold with no promotion

checklist.name: Threshold crossing named
checklist.description: The response notes that a sixth item crosses the five-item promotion threshold

checklist.name: Recorded as promoted not completed
checklist.description: If promotion happens, goal-status is set to promoted; it is never set to completed

checklist.name: Evidence carried across
checklist.description: Items 1 and 2 move to the plan as completed tasks with their commit SHAs intact

checklist.name: Completed work not re-opened
checklist.description: Already-proved work is not re-planned as outstanding

checklist.name: Trigger logged
checklist.description: The promotion is logged with the specific trigger that fired

checklist.name: Plan linked from related
checklist.description: The new plan's path is recorded in the goal's related frontmatter

checklist.name: No silent threshold gaming
checklist.description: Existing items are not parked or deleted purely to stay under the threshold without telling the user
